Subject: Re: Contract Questions

Hi Eliana,

Thanks for reaching out. I’m glad to hear you received the contract.

Regarding your questions, let’s schedule a brief call to discuss the payment terms and the non-compete clause. I am open to reviewing both to see if we can find a structure that works better for you while still meeting our project needs.

On top of that, you asked for a reminder on what animals pearls are typically found in. Pearls are typically found in mollusks, specifically oysters and mussels.

Let me know what time works best for you to chat.

Best,

Ms. Adams
